report_method: Current TTM profitability metric and negative volatility of the latest nine quarterly TTM observations are equally weighted.
implementation_proxy: Monthly signal panels are sampled at three-signal-month intervals to approximate consecutive quarterly TTM observations.
missing_value_rule: All nine historical observations must be present; no missing financial observation is filled with zero.
ronoa_role: Sensitivity-only. It remains ineligible for the main pool because strict RONOA raw coverage was insufficient before return testing.
